items.titleEn: Cease sits at 2nd in final AL Cy Young poll
bodyEn: With two weeks to go in the 2026 regular season, it sure looks like the AL and NL Cy Young Awards are all but wrapped up.

This has little to do with the field -- which is strong in both leagues -- and more to do with the frontrunners. The Yankees' Cam Schlittler and the Brewers' Jacob Misiorowski have simply slammed the door shut. Both high-octane hurlers were a unanimous choice in their respective leagues among our panel of 32 MLB.com voters in our final Cy Young poll of the year.

The experts cast their votes for who they think will take home the hardware based not only on the results so far, but also how they expect the final two weeks to shake out. Voters were asked to rank their top five picks in each league, with pitchers receiving points on a 5-4-3-2-1 scale -- five points for a first-place vote, four points for a second-place vote and so on.
Unless otherwise noted, all stats are through play on Sunday.
AMERICAN LEAGUE
1) Cam Schlittler, Yankees (160 total points; 32 first-place votes)

Schlittler blanked the Mets across six innings in the Subway Series finale on Sunday, lowering his season ERA to 1.95. Not only is that the best mark in the AL, it's also tied with Misiorowski for the lowest among qualified pitchers in the Majors. Schlittler has now allowed one run or fewer in each of his last seven starts, closing his first full Major League season with a flourish. He continues to overwhelm hitters with a three-fastball combo, the same formula that he used to burst onto the scene in the AL Wild Card Series last postseason. With October looming, an encore is right around the corner.
2) Dylan Cease, Blue Jays (126 points)

Cease has been nothing short of brilliant in the first year of a seven-year deal that he signed with the Blue Jays last November. He notched nine strikeouts in his most recent outing on Sunday against the Orioles, his 13th game this season with nine or more strikeouts -- more than any other AL pitcher. Cease's 236 strikeouts are a new single-season high and tied with Misiorowski for the most in the Majors. This year, Cease has used a more balanced pitch mix to supplement his lethal four-seam fastball/slider combo, giving him different ways to navigate opposing lineups. It's part of the reason why Cease's .177 batting average against is lowest among qualified AL pitchers.
3) Parker Messick, Guardians (77 points)

He may not be on the same level as Schlittler or Cease, but Messick has been undeniably fantastic in his rookie season. The funky left-hander allowed just one run in 5 1/3 innings in his last start against the Twins on Friday and, even in the heat of the pennant race, that is simply what Messick does. Schlittler and Cease are the only two AL pitchers to have more outings of five or more innings while allowing one run or fewer this season. Messick's 2.51 ERA is fifth best in the Majors. The four-seam fastball is the key to his success. Though Messick doesn't throw hard -- sitting just 94.3 mph -- his four-seamer has been one of the most valuable individual pitches in the Majors, according to Statcast's run value metric.
4) Drew Rasmussen, Rays (52 points)

On Friday, the Rays became the first team to clinch a postseason berth this year thanks to a dramatic walk-off home run from Junior Caminero. Not to be forgotten, Rasmussen started the game for Tampa Bay and breezed through seven innings of one-run ball. It shouldn't be a surprise that the Rays won because that is what they do when Rasmussen is on the hill: They have won each of his last 10 starts, a stretch that dates back to the All-Star break. The 31-year-old right-hander ranks in the top five in the AL in ERA (2.81), WHIP (0.92) and batting average against (.203), relying on three fastball shapes and impeccable command.
5) Sonny Gray, Red Sox (37 points)

Boston is coasting toward a postseason berth behind one of baseball's best pitching staffs. That sentence would have made sense on Opening Day, but not if you knew that left-hander Garrett Crochet would be sidelined since late April. In Crochet's absence, Gray has stepped up as the ace. He is 17-5 with a 2.76 ERA in 27 starts, and while pitcher wins aren't everything, it's noteworthy that no AL pitcher has more wins than Gray. He is vying for his third career top-five finish in AL Cy Young Award voting: He was the runner up with the Twins in 2023 and finished No. 3 with the Athletics in 2015.
Others receiving votes: Reid Detmers, Angels; Gavin Williams, Guardians; Nick Martinez, Rays; Michael Wacha, Royals
NATIONAL LEAGUE
1) Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers (160 total points, 32 first-place votes)

The Miz put a rare blip behind him with a sensational start last Tuesday, stifling the Cubs over 6 1/3 innings of one-run ball with nine strikeouts. The overpowering righty leads NL pitchers in nearly every statistical category, including ERA (1.95), batting average against (.155) and K's (236). Even with 161 1/3 innings under his belt, Misiorowski continues to bring the heat, too. He has now thrown 1,010 pitches at 100 mph or harder this season, more than double the next closest pitcher (Mason Miller, 468).
2) Chris Sale, Braves (106 points)

The ageless wonder has tried his best to close the gap in the NL Cy Young Award race down the stretch. Sale's 2.18 ERA is the second best in the NL and the lowest by the 37-year-old in a single season since 2018. He's been remarkably consistent, allowing three runs or fewer in each of his last 23 starts. No other starting pitcher has a stretch of more than 16 consecutive games allowing three runs or fewer this season. Sale is defying Father Time thanks in part to improved velocity, throwing harder than he ever has as a starting pitcher.
3) Cristopher Sánchez, Phillies (99 points)

Sánchez dropped a spot from our previous poll after allowing nine runs across his last two starts. Still, the lanky left-hander is putting together a season that merits plenty of Cy Young consideration. Sánchez has pitched the second-most innings in baseball (187 1/3) with the fifth best ERA (2.79) and third best FIP (2.72) among qualified NL pitchers. By Baseball Reference's version of WAR, Sánchez has been the most valuable pitcher in baseball in 2026, tallying 7.6 WAR.
4) Jesús Luzardo, Phillies (52 points)

Luzardo cracks our final Cy Young poll on the backs of a brilliant shutout against the NL East-leading Braves on Labor Day. It's well past time that the left-hander receives his flowers. Luzardo is 8-1 with a 1.66 ERA in his last 12 starts, posting the lowest ERA in the Majors since July 1 and winning the NL Pitcher of the Month Award in August. Buoyed by a lethal sweeper that he developed last season, Luzardo has the second-highest strikeout rate (30.4%) in the National League. Phillies fans are holding their breath after Luzardo missed his last start due to a shoulder ailment, though he said he was "not concerned" following his MRI.
5) Yoshinobu Yamamoto, Dodgers (43 points)

We have come to expect so much of Yamamoto that even his best performances feel routine -- like his seven-inning, 10-strikeout gem against the Reds last Wednesday. He is still the ace of a star-studded rotation befitting Hollywood, with a 2.62 ERA through 26 starts. Few pitchers are better at limiting traffic than Yamamoto, whose 0.88 WHIP and .184 batting average against are each second in the NL behind Misiorowski.
Others receiving votes: Chase Burns, Reds; Eduardo Rodriguez, D-backs; Mason Miller, Padres; Zack Wheeler, Phillies
items.titleZh: Dylan Cease 在美联赛扬奖最终民调中排名第二
items.summaryZh: 在2026赛季常规赛还剩两周之际，Dylan Cease 在美联赛扬奖最终民调中位列第二。
bodyZh: 随着2026赛季常规赛还剩两周，美联和国联的赛扬奖归属看起来似乎已经尘埃落定。
这与竞争激烈的候选人关系不大（两个联盟的竞争都很激烈），更多是因为领跑者表现过于强势。纽约洋基的 Cam Schlittler 和密尔沃基酿酒人的 Jacob Misiorowski 彻底锁定了胜局。在我们年度最后一次赛扬奖民调中，来自 MLB.com 的 32 位投票小组成员一致将选票投给了这两位火力全开的先发投手。
专家们不仅根据迄今为止的战绩，还结合对最后两周收官阶段的预期，投出了他们认为将捧起这座奖杯的人选。投票者被要求在每个联盟中按前五名进行排序，投手按 5-4-3-2-1 的分值获得积分——第一名得 5 分，第二名得 4 分，依此类推。
除非另有说明，所有统计数据均截至周日比赛结束。
美国联盟
1）Cam Schlittler，纽约洋基（总计 160 分；32 张第一名选票）

在周日地铁大战的收官战中，Schlittler 在 6 局投球中没有失分，将他的赛季自责分率降至 1.95。这不仅是美联的最佳成绩，也与 Misiorowski 并列大联盟所有达标投手中的最低自责分率。Schlittler 在最近的 7 场先发中每场都只失 1 分或更少，为他的第一个完整大联盟赛季画上了圆满的句号。他继续用三球速球组合压制打者，这正是他在上赛季季后赛美联外卡系列赛中崭露头角的秘诀。随着十月的临近，精彩表现即将来临。
2）Dylan Cease，多伦多蓝鸟（126 分）

去年 11 月与多伦多蓝鸟签下 7 年合同的第一年，Dylan Cease 的表现堪称惊艳。他在周日对阵巴尔的摩金莺的最近一次登场中送出 9 次三振，这是他本赛季第 13 场单场三振达到或超过 9 次的比赛——比任何其他美联投手都多。Dylan Cease 的 236 次三振创造了单季个人新高，并与 Misiorowski 并列大联盟最多。今年，Dylan Cease 在其致命的四缝线速球和滑球组合之外，采用了更均衡的球种搭配，为他应对对手打线提供了多种方式。这也是 Dylan Cease 的对手打击率仅有 .177、为美联达标投手最低的原因之一。
3）Parker Messick，克利夫兰守护者（77 分）

他可能不像 Schlittler 或 Dylan Cease 那样处于顶级水平，但 Messick 在新秀赛季的表现无疑是 fantastico。这位投球姿势独特的左投在周五对阵明尼苏达双城的上一场先发中，在 5 1/3 局里仅失 1 分，即使在激烈的季后赛席位争夺战中，这也是 Messick 一贯的风格。Schlittler 和 Dylan Cease 是本赛季仅有的两位能多次完成至少 5 局投球且失分在 1 分或以下的美国联盟投手。Messick 的 2.51 自责分率排名大联盟第五。四缝线速球是他成功的关键。尽管 Messick 的球速并不快——均速只有 94.3 英里/小时——但根据 Statcast 的跑分价值指标，他的四缝线速球依然是大联盟中最有价值的单项球种之一。
4）Drew Rasmussen，坦帕湾光芒（52 分）

周五，凭借 Junior Caminero 打出的戏剧性再见本垒打，坦帕湾光芒成为今年第一支锁定季后赛席位的球队。不容忽视的是，Rasmussen 当时为坦帕湾先发，轻松投完了 7 局仅失 1 分。光芒赢球并不让人意外，因为当 Rasmussen 在投手丘上时他们总是能赢：自全明星赛以来，他们赢下了他最近的 10 场先发。这位 31 岁的右投在自责分率（2.81）、WHIP（0.92）和对对手打击率（.203）方面均排名美联前五，他依靠的是三种不同形态的速球以及无可挑剔的控球。
5）Sonny Gray，波士顿红袜（37 分）

凭借全联盟最出色的投手阵容之一，波士顿正稳步迈向季后赛。如果在揭幕战时说这句话可能很合理，但如果你知道左投 Garrett Crochet 自 4 月下旬以来一直处于伤病名单中，可能就不会这么认为了。在 Crochet 缺阵的情况下，Gray 挺身而出成为了王牌。他在 27 场先发中取得 17 胜 5 负、自责分率 2.76 的成绩，虽然投手胜场数并不代表一切，但值得一提的是，没有任何美联投手的胜场数比 Gray 更多。他正在竞选职业生涯第三次在美联赛扬奖投票中进入前五：他曾在 2023 年效力明尼苏达双城时获得第二名，并在 2015 年效力运动家时排名第三。
其他获得选票的球员：Reid Detmers，洛杉矶天使；Gavin Williams，克利夫兰守护者；Nick Martinez，坦帕湾光芒；Michael Wacha，堪萨斯城皇家
国家联盟
1）Jacob Misiorowski，密尔沃基酿酒人（总计 160 分，32 张第一名选票）

The Miz 在上周二凭借一场轰动的先发将一次罕见的波动抛在脑后，他在 6 1/3 局的投球中压制了芝加哥小熊，仅失 1 分并送出 9 次三振。这位极具压制力的右投在几乎所有统计数据上都领跑国联投手，包括自责分率（1.95）、对对手打击率（.155）和三振数（236）。即便已经投了 161 1/3 局，Misiorowski 依然保持着火热的球速。本赛季他已经投出了 1,010 球球速达到或超过 100 英里/小时，是排名第二的投手（Mason Miller，468 球）的两倍多。
2）Chris Sale，亚特兰大勇士（106 分）

这位不老传奇在冲刺阶段竭尽全力缩小国联赛扬奖的争夺差距。Sale 的 2.18 自责分率是国联第二佳，也是这位 37 岁老将自 2018 年以来单赛季的最低纪录。他的表现异常稳定，在最近的 23 场先发中每场失分都在 3 分或以下。本赛季没有任何其他先发投手能连续超过 16 场比赛将失分控制在 3 分或以下。Sale 能够对抗岁月侵蚀，部分原因在于他提升了球速，其投球威力甚至超过了他作为先发投手的任何时期。
3）Cristopher Sánchez，费城费城人（99 分）

由于最近两场比赛共失 9 分，Sánchez 在我们的上期民调中下滑了一位。尽管如此，这位身材高瘦的左投所打出的赛季表现依然值得大量赛扬奖的讨论。在国联达标投手中，Sánchez 的投球局数（187 1/3 局）高居全联盟第二，自责分率（2.79）排名第五，FIP（2.72）排名第三。根据 Baseball Reference 版本的 WAR，Sánchez 是 2026 年大联盟中最有价值的投手，累计贡献了 7.6 的 WAR。
4）Jesús Luzardo，费城费城人（52 分）

凭借在劳动节对阵国联东区领头羊亚特兰大勇士时的一场精彩完封，Luzardo 跻身我们最终的赛扬奖民调。这位左投获得赞誉的时机早已成熟。Luzardo 在最近的 12 场先发中取得 8 胜 1 负、自责分率 1.66 的战绩，创下了自 7 月 1 日以来大联盟最低的自责分率，并赢得了 8 月份的国联月度最佳投手奖。在去年开发出的致命横扫球（sweeper）的加持下，Luzardo 拥有国联第二高的三振率（30.4%）。由于肩部不适缺席了上一场先发，费城人球迷正屏息以待，不过他在接受核磁共振检查后表示自己“并不担心”。
5）Yoshinobu Yamamoto，洛杉矶道奇（43 分）

我们对 Yamamoto 的期望已经如此之高，以至于连他最出色的表现也显得像是常规操作——比如上周三对阵辛辛那提红人时投出 7 局送出 10 次三振的惊艳表现。他依然是这支星光熠熠、符合好莱坞气质的先发轮值阵容的王牌，在 26 场先发中交出了 2.62 的自责分率。很少有投手能像 Yamamoto 那样出色地限制垒上有人，他的 0.88 WHIP 和 .184 的对对手打击率均在国联仅次于 Misiorowski，排名第二。
其他获得选票的球员：Chase Burns，辛辛那提红人；Eduardo Rodriguez，亚利桑那响尾蛇；Mason Miller，圣迭戈教士；Zack Wheeler，费城费城人

items.titleEn: VOTE NOW: Here are the 2026 Roberto Clemente Award nominees
bodyEn: The Roberto Clemente Award is one of the most prestigious honors in Major League Baseball. This year’s Clemente Award nominees were announced on MLB Network on Monday morning ahead of MLB’s annual Roberto Clemente Day, which takes place each year on Sept. 15 -- which also marks the beginning of National Hispanic Heritage Month.

Roberto Clemente Day was established by MLB in 2002 to honor the legacy of the Hall of Famer and 15-time All-Star who tragically died in a plane crash on New Year's Eve 1972 while on his way to deliver supplies to earthquake victims in Nicaragua.

The Roberto Clemente Award is presented each year to the player who best represents the game through extraordinary character, community involvement, philanthropy and positive contributions, both on and off the field. Prior to Clemente’s death, MLB’s annual award for philanthropic efforts was named the “Commissioner’s Award,” but it was renamed the “Roberto Clemente Award” in 1973.
All-time Clemente Award winners

One player from each club is nominated each year. This year’s nominees include seven 2026 All-Stars and 14 first-time nominees. The nominees will be recognized in ballparks beginning on Tuesday, this year’s Roberto Clemente Day presented by Capital One.
This year’s 30 nominees are:

Angels: Zach Neto*Astros: Josh HaderAthletics: Zack Gelof*Blue Jays: George SpringerBraves: Austin Riley*Brewers: Christian YelichCardinals: Jordan Walker*Cubs: Dansby Swanson*D-backs: Corbin CarrollDodgers: Will SmithGiants: Logan Webb*Guardians: Joey Cantillo*Mariners: Julio Rodríguez*Marlins: Otto Lopez*Mets: Francisco LindorNationals: Nasim Nuñez*Orioles: Pete AlonsoPadres: Jason AdamPhillies: Kyle SchwarberPirates: Brandon LoweRangers: Jake Burger*Rays: Cedric Mullins*Red Sox: Garrett Whitlock*Reds: Jose TrevinoRockies: Kyle FreelandRoyals: Bobby Witt Jr.Tigers: Justin VerlanderTwins: Pablo LópezWhite Sox: Davis Martin*Yankees: Carlos Rodón
* Denotes first-time nominee

The winner of the Roberto Clemente Award presented by Capital One will be selected by a blue-ribbon panel, and he will be honored during the 2026 World Series. The panel consists of representatives from the Commissioner’s Office, Capital One, MLB-affiliated networks (MLB Network, FOX Sports, ESPN, NBC Sports, Netflix and TBS), MLB.com, the National Baseball Hall of Fame and Roberto’s children -- Enrique, Luis and Roberto Jr.

Fans can vote for the Roberto Clemente Award by going to www.mlbtogether.com/clementeaward (in both English and Spanish). Fans can cast their vote until the end of the regular season on Sunday, Sept. 27. The fan vote will count as one vote among those cast by the blue-ribbon panel.

bodyZh: 罗伯托·克莱门特奖是美国职业棒球大联盟最具声望的荣誉之一。今年的克莱门特奖候选人于周一上午在MLB Network上公布，正值大联盟一年一度的罗伯托·克莱门特日之前，该节日每年于9月15日举行，这也标志着全国西班牙裔传统月的开始。
罗伯托·克莱门特日由大联盟于2002年设立，旨在纪念这位名人堂成员兼15次入选全明星的传奇球星。他在1972年除夕夜不幸在一次空难中遇难，当时他正搭乘飞机前往尼加拉瓜向地震灾民运送物资。

历届克莱门特奖得主
每年每支球馆各有一名球员获得提名。今年的候选人包括7名2026年全明星球员和14名首次获得提名的球员。候选人将从周二开始在各大球场接受表彰，今年由Capital One呈现的罗伯托·克莱门特日也将于同日举行。

items.titleEn: These rookies have been huge for Toronto in an unpredictable season
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- Nothing has gone how it was supposed to this season, even the good things.
Look back to Spring Training and dig up some of those predictions from February and March. I’ve asked for mine to be scrubbed from the internet, but with little success.

Addison Barger was the popular pick to be the Blue Jays’ breakout star, but he appeared in just nine games, recorded one base hit and eventually underwent season-ending elbow surgery in late July. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was supposed to carry over his spectacular World Series performance into 2026, but it’s been a complete flop. The Blue Jays were supposed to have “too much starting pitching depth," but this rotation is being held together with bubble gum and tape.

That’s the bad news. If it weren’t for some surprise stories along the way, the Blue Jays would have cratered long ago, but it’s been the kids who have kept them afloat. First, it was Brandon Valenzuela, who stepped in admirably when Alejandro Kirk went down, and it’s only grown from there, a credit to the Blue Jays’ player development staff which has a knack for turning these prospects on the cusp into useful big leaguers.
These have been the rookie stars:
The new leadoff man: Brett Bateman

When the Blue Jays landed Bateman from the Cubs as part of the Kevin Gausman package, it didn’t move the needle much. He was the Cubs’ No. 20 prospect at the time. A generous take at the time was that, perhaps in 2027, he could fill the Myles Straw role.

Well, since Bateman made his big league debut on Aug. 7, he is tied for 8th in fWAR across all hitters. The only players with a higher WAR since then are: Alex Bregman, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Fernando Tatis Jr., Rafael Devers, Tristan Peters, Pete Alonso and Jackson Chourio. Have you heard of them?

Bateman still needs to win the adjustments game down the stretch and well into 2027 -- and this good fortune on balls in play won’t last forever -- but this has been incredible to watch. Bateman isn’t just putting up numbers in the leadoff spot, he’s completely changed the feel of this lineup with his speed and aggression on the bases.
The story of the season: Spencer Miles

When the Blue Jays selected Miles in the Rule 5 Draft last December, reactions ranged from “Who?” to “Why?” Manager John Schneider’s first reaction was that, if the Blue Jays are selecting a Rule 5 pitcher coming off a World Series run, he’d better be pretty [bleeping] good. He is.

Miles is the best story of 2026, plucked from obscurity to become one of the most important pitchers on this roster. He flirts with triple digits with his brilliant sinker, and by next spring, we’re likely talking about a starting pitcher. What a find by this front office.
With a 2.71 ERA over 89 2/3 innings, Miles could flirt with 100 by the end of the season. That’s a fine foundation to build from, giving him a shot at 130-plus next season in a longer role.
The X-factor: Sean Keys
This team is tied for 26th in baseball with just 147 home runs this season. Sean Keys has hit 30 homers this season between Double-A, Triple-A and the big leagues. You can do the math here.
If there’s one player who could break a game open down the stretch and have a "moment," it’s Keys.

Keys has shot up to the club’s No. 6 prospect with a dominant season in the Minor Leagues. He possesses the trait this organization needs most, which is the ability to drive the baseball, and he’s earned rave reviews from coaches at every level.
Now, Keys just needs to do it in the big leagues. When he returned to Toronto for the second time this season, Schneider’s assignment for him was clear, to hit breaking balls.

“It’s definitely about timing,” Keys said. “Most of the time, I would say that with my swing, I’m trying to be on time for the heater and adjust from there. Sometimes, guys have too much velo or too much break where you can think, ‘Well, he’s not going to throw a fastball here, so I might as well be on time for this speed.’ A lot of times, a changeup or a slider are the same velo, so I can be on time for both of those.”
It will only take a big swing or two against a righty, and Keys will get his shots down the stretch to be the next rookie contributor.
items.titleZh: 这些菜鸟在多伦多变化莫测的赛季中表现惊艳
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在这个多事之秋的赛季中，凭借几位年轻新秀的出色发挥稳住了阵脚。
bodyZh: 本文摘自Keegan Matheson的Blue Jays Beat通讯。要阅读完整通讯请点击这里，并订阅以定期在收件箱中接收。
多伦多讯——本赛季没有什么事情是按计划进行的，甚至连好事也是如此。
回看春训，翻出那些二月和三月的预测。我已经要求把我的预测从互联网上删除，但收效甚微。
Addison Barger曾被普遍看好会成为多伦多蓝鸟的爆发之星，但他仅出场9场比赛，仅敲出一支安打，并最终在7月下旬接受了赛季报销的手术。Vladimir Guerrero Jr.本应将他在世界大赛上的惊艳表现延续到2026年，但结果却彻底惨败。多伦多蓝鸟本该拥有“过于雄厚的先发投手深度”，但如今这支先发轮值却靠着口香糖和胶带勉强维持。
这是坏消息。如果不是一路上涌现出一些意想不到的故事，多伦多蓝鸟早就崩溃了，正是这些年轻球员让他们坚持到了今天。首先是Brandon Valenzuela，他在Alejandro Kirk倒下时顶替上阵表现出色，随后这种势头不断蔓延，这也归功于多伦多蓝鸟的球员发展团队，他们善于将这些濒临成熟的潜力新秀转变为大联盟的实用干将。
以下是这些新秀明星：
全新开路先锋：Brett Bateman
当多伦多蓝鸟从芝加哥小熊交易得到Brett Bateman作为Kevin Gausman交易筹码的一部分时，并没有引起多大轰动。当时他是芝加哥小熊排名第20位的潜力新秀。当时一种比较宽容的看法是，也许在2027年，他可以扮演Myles Straw的角色。
然而，自从Brett Bateman于8月7日完成大联盟首秀以来，他在所有打者的fWAR排行榜上并列第8位。自那以后fWAR比他高的球员只有：Alex Bregman、Pete Crow-Armstrong、Fernando Tatis Jr.、Rafael Devers、Tristan Peters、Pete Alonso和Jackson Chourio。你听说过他们吗？
Brett Bateman仍然需要在赛季末段以及2027年继续适应各种调整，而且他在球场上的这种好运也不会永远持续下去，但看着他的表现实在令人惊叹。Brett Bateman不仅在第一棒的位置上交出数据，还用他的速度和在垒上的侵略性彻底改变了这支打线给人的感觉。
赛季的故事：Spencer Miles
当多伦多蓝鸟在去年12月的规则五选秀中挑中Spencer Miles时，反应从“他是谁？”到“为什么选他？”不等。总教练John Schneider的第一反应是，如果多伦多蓝鸟要在经历世界大赛征程后选择一名规则五投手，那他最好得[该死地]优秀。他的确很优秀。
Spencer Miles是2026赛季最棒的故事，他从默默无闻一跃成为这支球阵容中最关键的投手之一。他那出色的伸卡球球速直逼三位数，到了明年春天，我们很可能会讨论他成为先发投手的事。管理层真是慧眼识珠。
凭借在89.2局投球中交出的2.71自责分率，Spencer Miles在本赛季结束时甚至可能接近100局。这是一个很好的建队基础，能让他在下个赛季承担更长的局数时，有机会冲击130局以上。
X因素：Sean Keys
本赛季这支球队以147支本垒打并列全美职第26位。Sean Keys本赛季在2A、3A和大联盟总共轰出了30发本垒打。你可以自己算算这笔账。
如果说有哪位球员能在赛季末段打破僵局并迎来“高光时刻”，那就是Sean Keys.
凭借在小联盟的统治级表现，Sean Keys一跃成为俱乐部排名第6位的潜力新秀。他拥有这个组织最需要的特质，那就是强力击球的能力，并赢得了各级教练的一致好评。
现在，Sean Keys只需要在大联盟中证明自己。当他本赛季第二次回到多伦多时，John Schneider给他的任务很明确，那就是击打变化球。
“这绝对关乎时机，”Sean Keys说道，“大多数时候，我认为以我的挥棒方式，我是在努力对准直球的时机，然后据此做出调整。有时，投手球速太快或变化太大，你会想‘好吧，他不会在这里投直球的，所以我最好配合这个速度。’很多时候，变速球和滑球的球速是一样的，所以我可以同时配合这两种球速。”
只需对右投手挥出精彩的一两棒，Sean Keys就能在赛季末段获得机会，成为下一位贡献力量的新秀。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays maintain standing in Wild Card behind back-to-back-to-back homers
items.summaryEn: It’s been 14 years since the Blue Jays last hit three consecutive home runs
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Doesn’t this team feel different than it did when you woke up this morning?

There’s something about watching Vladimir Guerrero Jr. finally hit a home run out of Rogers Centre that can tempt you into believing again. The 8-1 victory to win the series over the Orioles doesn’t hurt, either.
This is what mattered most from a crucial day at the ballpark for the Blue Jays:
1. AL Wild Card picture

This win moves the Blue Jays within a half-game of the Guardians, who are currently playing the Twins in the finale of a three-game set. A Guardians win would keep the Blue Jays one game back of that final Wild Card spot, but since they hold the tiebreaker over Cleveland after winning the season series, it’s even closer than it looks.

The other key movement of the day is the Orioles sliding three games behind the Blue Jays in the AL Wild Card standings. A loss today would have drawn them within one game with another three-game series waiting next week in Baltimore (Sept. 21-23), leaving an awfully dangerous door cracked open. The Orioles are still a threat, along with the Rangers, but the Blue Jays have much more control over their own destiny after holding off the O’s.

One other wrinkle to track: The AL Central is getting tight at the top, with the Guardians 1 1/2 games behind the White Sox. If that flips, and the White Sox end up as the third Wild Card team, the Blue Jays do not hold that tiebreaker if they’re stuck trying to chase Chicago down.
2. Back to back to back

The first runs of the game from each team felt a bit cheap, a flared base hit into the shallow outfield on either side of the diamond. In the fifth inning, however, the Blue Jays decided to do away with that and set up a launching pad.

After George Springer gave them the lead with his 15th home run of the season to right field, Vladdy launched his game-changing home run, followed by Kazuma Okamoto, who sent a no-doubter to left. Okamoto already holds the growing record for most home runs by a rookie in franchise history, but with his home run on Sunday, he also set the new rookie RBI record with 85, passing Eric Hinske, who had 84 RBIs in 2002.

It’s been 14 years since the Blue Jays last hit three consecutive home runs. You’d have to go all the way back to June 9, 2012, against the Brewers, when Colby Rasmus, José Bautista and Edwin Encarnacion pulled it off.
3. Help is on the way?

Early Sunday, around 11 a.m. local time, Trey Yesavage bounced out of the Blue Jays’ dugout in full uniform and walked into left field. After warming up, he continued to the bullpen where he threw in front of the Blue Jays’ pitching coaches, perhaps the final step before he gets into a rehab game later this coming week.

After throwing, Yesavage went to the infield and ran through some fielding drills, which is crucial. Yesavage underwent surgery in early August to repair the meniscus in his left knee, and while throwing off a mound is one hurdle to clear, moving around on the field could be an even bigger one. How Yesavage recovers tomorrow will be key, but the eye test checked out. Yesavage looked like himself.

Let’s dream on the perfect outcome, then. If Yesavage pitches later this week, likely with Triple-A Buffalo, he could return as soon as next week’s series (Sept. 21-23) against the Orioles in Baltimore. Whether it’s late in that series or in the final set of the season against the Reds at home (Sept. 25-27), Yesavage could potentially give the Blue Jays 3-4 innings by then.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟凭借连续三记本垒打巩固外卡席位
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟轰出连续三支本垒打，击败金莺巩固美联外卡位置。
bodyZh: 多伦多——这支球队是不是让你觉得和今天早上醒来时有些不一样了？
看着 Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 终于在罗杰斯中心轰出一记本垒打，总能让你重新燃起希望。以 8-1 赢下比赛并取下巴尔的摩金莺的系列赛胜利，同样让人心情大好。
这是蓝鸟在球场度过关键一天中最重要的事情：
1. 美联外卡形势
这场胜利让多伦多蓝鸟与克利夫兰守护者的差距缩小至半场胜差，后者当时正在进行三连战的最后一场对阵明尼苏达双城。守护者的胜利将让蓝鸟距离最后一个外卡席位保持一场胜差，但由于蓝鸟在赛季交手中占优从而手握对赛优势，实际差距比看上去还要近。
当天另一个关键变动是，巴尔地摩金莺在美联外卡榜上落后蓝鸟三场胜差。如果今天输球，双方差距将被拉近到一场，而下周（9月21日至23日）双方还将在巴尔的摩进行另一场三连战，这会留下一道极其危险的缝隙。金莺和得克萨斯游骑兵依然具有威胁，但在顶住金莺的冲击后，蓝鸟对自己的命运有了更多掌控力。
另一个需要追踪的变动是：美联中区榜首竞争正变得白热化，守护者落后芝加哥白袜 1.5 场胜差。如果这种局面发生翻转，白袜最终成为第三支外卡球队，而蓝鸟如果陷入追赶芝加哥的境地，将不持有对赛优势。
2. 连续三记本垒打
两支球队本场比赛的第一分都显得有些侥幸，都是落在内野浅区的飘忽安打。然而在第五局，多伦多蓝鸟决定抛开这一点，彻底点燃了进攻火力。
在 George Springer 轰出个人本季第 15 号右外野本垒打帮助球队取得领先之后，Vladdy 轰出了改变比赛的本垒打，紧接着 Kazuma Okamoto 将球毫无悬念地轰向左外野。Okamoto 已经刷新了队史新秀本垒打纪录，而在周日的这记本垒打帮助他以 85 分打点创造了新的队史新秀打点纪录，超越了 Eric Hinske 在 2002 年创下的 84 分打点。
距离多伦多蓝鸟上一次轰出连续三记本垒打已经过去 14 年了。你必须回溯到 2012 年 6 月 9 日对阵密尔沃基酿酒人的比赛，当时 Colby Rasmus、José Bautista 和 Edwin Encarnacion 联手完成了这一壮举。
3. 强援正在路上？
周日早晨当地时间 11 点左右，Trey Yesavage 身穿全套球衣从蓝鸟的休息区跑出，走向左外野。热身过后，他前往牛棚在蓝鸟的投手教练面前进行投球，这或许是他接下来一周参加复健赛前的最后一步。
投球结束后，Yesavage 前往内野进行了一些守备训练，这至关重要。Yesavage 在 8 月初接受了手术以修复左膝半月板，虽然在投手丘上投球是一道坎，但在场上移动可能是更大的考验。Yesavage 明天的恢复情况将是关键，但从肉眼观察来看情况不错，Yesavage 看起来状态恢复了正常。
那么，让我们来设想一下最完美的结局。如果 Yesavage 本周晚些时候登板投球，很可能是在三藩市小联盟的 3A 布法罗，他最早可能在下周对阵巴尔的摩金莺的系列赛（9月21日至23日）中复出。无论是在该系列赛的后期，还是在主场对阵辛辛那提红人的赛季收官系列赛（9月25日至27日）中，届时 Yesavage 都有望为蓝鸟投出 3 到 4 局。

items.titleEn: Home(r) at last! Vladdy goes deep in Toronto for first time in 2026
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. didn’t move an inch. He wasn’t leaving the box until that ball left the yard.
Finally, he had done it.
In his 289th plate appearance of 2026 and the 150th game of the season, Guerrero hit one out at Rogers Centre, in the fifth inning off Orioles starter Trevor Rogers.

He stood like a statue over home plate, his bat pointed up towards the left-field corner of the stadium as his ball soared out. It didn’t clear the wall by much, but Guerrero knew it. Even though it’s been a while, he knew it.

This is the moment that Guerrero, the Blue Jays and their fans have been waiting for. He’s teased us so many times in 2026 – in Chicago, Los Angeles, Detroit and Boston. He’s teased us up and down both coasts, from San Diego and San Francisco, across to Philadelphia and even in Cleveland, but never at the place he calls home in Toronto. All season, Rogers Centre has been waiting to erupt around Guerrero.

We haven’t seen this since that breathtaking 2025 postseason run, when Guerrero homered eight times in 18 games and put the Blue Jays on his back. That’s what it’s supposed to look like: the $500 million man standing out in front leading the way, but it’s been a while. Guerrero hasn’t hit a regular-season home run here since Aug. 17, 2025, against the Rangers, and his last Rogers Centre homer overall came in Game 6 of the ALCS against the Mariners on Oct. 19, 2025.

What a time for it to happen, too, because for all of the close calls Guerrero has had throughout the season, his second at-bat on Sunday was the closest he’s been. Guerrero shot a rocket to right-center field, but it smacked high off the wall at 397 feet, just a foot or two shy of leaving the yard.

Here’s the kicker, though. According to Statcast, that double was blown in -11 feet by the wind swirling inside Rogers Centre. Guerrero had just been robbed of a home run by… the wind. He’s battled everything in 2026, from his swing, to his body, to the incredible pressure that’s come with this slump, and now he’d been robbed by an invisible force.

The moment that zero became a one at home, though, you could feel the Blue Jays become lighter. The sellout crowd, understanding exactly what that home run meant, roared until Guerrero popped out the other end of the dugout for a curtain call, still wearing the red home run jacket and beaming.
Finally, it’s over. Now, Guerrero can just focus on hitting his next one.
items.titleZh: 终于在主场开轰！Vladdy 在 2026 赛季首次于多伦多轰出本垒打
items.summaryZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 打出了 2026 赛季在罗杰斯中心的首支本垒打。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯 —— Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 一步也没有移动。在球飞出球场之前，他没有离开打击区。
终于，他做到了。
在 2026 赛季的第 289 次打击机会以及本赛季的第 150 场比赛中，Guerrero 在罗杰斯中心从巴尔的摩金莺先发投手 Trevor Rogers 手中敲出了一支本垒打，时间是在第五局。
他像一尊雕像一样站在本垒板上方，球棒指向球场左外野角落，看着自己的击球高高飞出。这记击球并未飞离围墙太远，但 Guerrero 心里清楚。尽管已经有一段时间没能在主场开轰，但他就是知道。
这是 Guerrero、多伦多蓝鸟以及球迷们一直在等待的时刻。他在 2026 赛季已经无数次吊起人们的胃口 —— 在芝加哥、洛杉矶、底特律和波士顿。他在东西海岸到处制造悬念，从圣迭戈和旧金山，到费城，甚至在克利夫兰，但唯独没能在他在多伦多称为家的这座球场做到。整个赛季，罗杰斯中心一直在等待为 Guerrero 的本垒打而沸腾。

自从 2025 年那段惊心动魄的季后赛之旅以来，我们就再也没见过这样的场景了。当时 Guerrero 在 18 场比赛中轰出 8 支本垒打，凭一己之力扛着多伦多蓝鸟前进。这才是它本该有的样子：身价 5 亿美元的球星挺身而出引领球队，但这已经过去一段时间了。Guerrero 自 2025 年 8 月 17 日对阵得克萨斯游骑兵以来，就再也没有在这里打过常规赛本垒打，而他上一次在罗杰斯中心轰出本垒打，还要追溯到 2025 年 10 月 19 日美联冠军赛对阵西雅图水手的第六场比赛。
这也是一个绝佳的时机，因为尽管 Guerrero 全赛季经历过多次擦肩而过，但他周日的第二个打席已经是离本垒打最近的一次。Guerrero 将球轰出一记飞向右中外野的强劲平飞球，但球重重地砸在 397 英尺处的全垒打墙高处，距离飞出球场仅差一两英尺。
然而，最令人叫绝的是。根据 Statcast 的数据，罗杰斯中心内部盘旋的风将那记二垒安打往回吹了 -11 英尺。Guerrero 的本垒打刚刚被……风给没收了。他在 2026 赛季与一切进行了抗争，从自己的挥棒、身体，到这次低迷期带来的巨大压力，而现在他又被一股看不见的力量掠夺了本垒打。
不过，当主场本垒打栏上的数字从零变成一时，你可以感觉到多伦多蓝鸟全队都轻松了。全场爆满的观众完全理解这记本垒打的意义，他们大声欢呼，直到 Guerrero 再次从休息区走出来谢幕，他身上依然穿着红色的本垒打夹克，脸上带着灿烂的笑容。
终于，这一切都结束了。现在，Guerrero 可以专注于打出他的下一支本垒打。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays play with sense of urgency to gain in AL Wild Card chase
bodyEn: TORONTO -- One day after looking like a team with no shot at the postseason, the Blue Jays pulled everyone back in. Over and over again, they keep doing it.

Saturday afternoon’s 7-3 win over the Orioles was bold and convincing, an immediate reversal of the energy that filled Rogers Centre the night before. The Blue Jays (74-75) now sit just one game behind the Guardians (75-74) for the final American League Wild Card spot. This win also keeps the Orioles (72-77) two games behind Toronto.
This is what mattered most:
1. The AL Wild Card picture

Holding off the O’s is crucial, especially with another three games in Baltimore coming up from Sept. 21-23. A few bad days could flip this race on the Blue Jays quickly, so picking up one win from this series ahead of Dylan Cease’s start in Sunday’s finale was necessary.
It’s officially scoreboard watching season, and as soon as Saturday’s win was over, all eyes went to the Guardians and Rangers games already underway.

“[Urgency] has been high for a couple of months,” manager John Schneider said. “I think it’s going to be like that all the way to the end. Every game matters and there are still important games that are going to be played all the way down the stretch. The urgency level has been high for a while, as has stress, as has everything.”
2. Brett Bateman, power hitter???
Not even 24 hours after launching his first career MLB home run, Bateman launched his second to almost the exact same spot. What’s going on here?

Bateman never homered in college over 128 games with the Minnesota Golden Gophers, then homered just six times across parts of four Minor League seasons. He’s always been the contact guy, using his great speed on the bases and excellent defense to support most of his value, but these past two games against the Orioles have shown us something completely unexpected.

Bateman isn’t going to turn into José Bautista, just like his BABIP isn’t going to sustain with all of these base hits finding holes, but that’s not the point right now. If Bateman can just drive the ball more consistently and pull six or eight balls over the wall each season, that helps to round out his offensive profile and could save him -- at least a bit -- from the typical “luck” fluctuations on balls in play that contact hitters face from year to year.
3. Miles sticks the landing ... again

The first inning wasn’t pretty, with the bases loaded and a fly ball to the base of the wall to end the inning, but any “zero” on the scoreboard works. Spencer Miles gave the Blue Jays two of those, and with a 2.71 ERA over 89 2/3 innings, he remains one of the best stories on this team.

This is the role Miles will fill the rest of the season, but things get much more interesting this coming offseason. Miles wants to be a starter, and it sounds like the Blue Jays are thinking right along with him.

“You can always add on a few innings to whatever he finishes with this year and it’s nice to think of him as a starter,” Schneider said. “We’ll cross that bridge in the offseason and give him a full offseason to get prepared for whatever role. He’s been really good for multiple innings out of the bullpen, too, so that will be an interesting one to solve. I think the potential is there to be a starter. He’s got the weapons to be a starter.”

items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟以7比3击败巴尔的摩金莺，在美联外卡争夺战中紧咬对手。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——就在前一天看起来还像是一支无缘季后赛的球队之后，多伦多蓝鸟将所有人重新拉回了竞争行列。他们一次又一次地这样做。
周六下午以7比3战胜巴尔的摩金莺是一场酣畅淋漓且令人信服的胜利，瞬间扭转了前一晚充斥在罗杰斯中心的低迷氛围。多伦多蓝鸟（74胜75负）目前在争夺美联最后一个外卡席位上仅落后克利夫兰守护者（75胜74负）一场胜差。这场胜利也让巴尔的摩金莺（72胜77负）落后多伦多两场胜差。
以下是最为关键的几点：
1. 美联外卡形势
抵挡住巴尔的摩金莺的冲击至关重要，特别是9月21日至23日即将迎来在巴尔的摩的又一个三连战。几天的不顺就可能迅速让多伦多蓝鸟在这次争夺中翻船，因此在周日收官战Dylan Cease先发登场前，从本系列赛中拿下这场胜利是必须的。
这正式进入了看记分牌的季节，周六的比赛一结束，所有人的目光就转向了已经开打的克利夫兰守护者和得克萨斯游骑兵的比赛。
“（紧迫感）几个月来一直很高，”总教练John Schneider表示。“我认为这种情况会一直持续到最后。每一场比赛都很重要，在冲刺阶段还会有许多关键比赛要打。紧迫感已经维持了一段时间，压力也是，所有的一切都是。”
2. Brett Bateman，强力打者？？？
甚至在轰出个人大联盟生涯首支本垒打不到24小时后，Brett Bateman就轰出了他的第二支，落点几乎在完全相同的位置。这到底是怎么回事？
Brett Bateman在大学效力明尼苏达金地鼠队期间的128场比赛中从未打出过本垒打，随后在四个小联盟赛季的征战中也只打出了6支本垒打。他一直是一个擅长接触球的打者，主要依靠出色的跑垒速度和优秀的防守来支撑大部分价值，但过去对阵巴尔的摩金莺这两场比赛向我们展示了完全意想不到的东西。
Brett Bateman不会变成José Bautista，就像他的场内安打率（BABIP）不会在所有这些安打都能找到空档的情况下持续维持高位一样，但这并不是目前的重点。如果Brett Bateman能够更稳定地击球，并且每个赛季能有六到八个球飞过全垒打墙，这将有助于完善他的进攻属性，并且能帮他——至少在一定程度上——摆脱接触型打者年复一年所面临的典型场内安打“运气”波动。
3. Spencer Miles再次完美着陆……
第一局并不好看，当时满垒且有一记飞球打到墙脚结束了这一局，但记分牌上的任何“零”都管用。Spencer Miles为多伦多蓝鸟贡献了两局这样的表现，凭借在89又2/3局中投出的2.71自责分率，他依然是这支球队中最棒的故事之一。
这就是Spencer Miles在今年剩余赛季中将扮演的角色，但到了今年即将到来的休赛期，事情将变得更加有趣。Spencer Miles想要成为先发投手，听起来多伦多蓝鸟的想法也与他不谋而合。
“你总是可以在他今年最终完成的投球局数上再加几局，将他视为一名先发投手是很不错的想法，”John Schneider说。“我们将在休赛期再讨论这个问题，并给他一个完整的休赛期来为任何角色做好准备。他在牛棚投多局的表现也非常出色，所以这将是一个有趣需要解决的问题。我认为他有成为先发投手的潜力。他具备成为先发投手的武器。”

items.titleEn: High-A Blue Jays claim 2026 title -- these are the prospects who led them
bodyEn: In a 12-inning game that stretched late into the night, the High-A Vancouver Canadians outlasted the Eugene Emeralds on Friday to complete a three-game sweep and secure the 2026 Northwest League title.

Much like the first two games of the series, the clincher was a back-and-forth affair. The Canadians led early before falling behind in the middle innings, ultimately entering the eighth down by four runs. David Calabrese, a Richmond Hill, Ontario native, flipped the script with two outs in the ninth inning, crushing a game-tying homer.

Both teams tallied a run in the 10th and went scoreless in the 11th, seemingly reaching a stalemate. But the first pitch in the 12th inning changed that as Ryan Sprock singled to center field, driving home the go-ahead run. The Canadians held onto the lead for a 9-8 win at PK Park, their third one-run victory in as many games.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »

It marks Vancouver’s first league title since 2023. It also marks the first time since 2022 that the league's Championship Series has been won via a sweep -- the roles were reversed that season with Eugene toppling Vancouver.

The Canadians have been somewhat of a fixture in the Northwest League playoffs, making an appearance in four of the last six seasons. This year got off to a rocky start as they dropped their first five games but a combination of old and new names helped turn the tide, while some midseason additions maintained the momentum throughout the playoff push and the Championship Series.
JoJo Parker, SS

The Blue Jays’ first-round pick in the 2025 Draft, Parker got his first taste of professional baseball this year. Currently the organization’s No. 1 prospect, he wasted no time in showing off his talent. He impressed in 87 games with Single-A Dunedin, earning a promotion to Vancouver on Aug. 10. The 20-year-old didn’t miss a beat -- he put together a seven-game hit streak to start his High-A tenure. He closed the regular season with a .316 average across 21 games for the Canadians.

Batting in the leadoff spot, Parker came to the plate in some crucial situations during the postseason series. In Game 1, he hit an RBI double, driving in the tying run in the sixth. In the bottom of the eighth of Game 2, he collected a single and a walk. Although he went hitless in Game 3, he scored the winning run, ending a 12-inning gridlock. All in all, he ended his first pro season with some extra quality at-bats and a championship title.
Dasan Hill, LHP ... and Nolan Perry, RHP and Johnny King, LHP

For the early part of the year, the Canadians’ bats were complemented by the arms of Perry and King, the Blue Jays’ No. 2 and No. 3 prospects, respectively. Perry was promoted to Double-A in June, while King remained at High-A until August, racking up a team-leading 112 strikeouts. But when both had moved onto New Hampshire, it was time to pass the proverbial torch. Enter Hill, the club's No. 8 prospect.

Hill joined the organization in the Jeff Hoffman Trade Deadline deal and made five crucial starts for Vancouver down the stretch, including what became the playoff spot clincher on Sept. 2. He allowed one run over three innings, while striking out four batters. The 6-foot-5 southpaw returned to the mound to start Game 1 and allowed one earned run in his two innings of work.
David Calabrese, OF

A graduate of Saint Elizabeth Catholic High School in Thornhill, Ontario, Calabrese returned to Canada when he was signed by the Blue Jays to a Minor League contract on Aug. 12. A third-round pick of the Angels in the 2020 Draft, he started the season with Double-A Rocket City before he was released. He immediately made an impact on the Vancouver lineup and caught fire in the final week of the regular season, earning Northwest League Player of the Week honors after going 14-for-28 with a 1.321 OPS and five stolen bases. Prior to the start of the playoffs, he posted a .348 average with three home runs and 10 RBIs during his 16-game stint with the Canadians.

The 23-year-old started Game 1 on the bench before coming in as a defensive substitution in the sixth inning. He led off the bottom of the inning and hit a triple, sparking a rally. In Game 2, he posted three hits. Those performances paled in comparison to his game-tying homer in the top of the ninth of Game 3 that completed a four-run comeback. Overall, he went 6-for-12 with three extra-base hits and a stolen base in the series.
items.titleZh: 高阶1A多伦多蓝鸟夺得2026赛季冠军：带队晋级的潜力新秀
items.summaryZh: 高阶1A温哥华加拿大人队在12局苦战后横扫对手，夺得2026年西北联盟冠军。
bodyZh: 在一场一直打到深夜的12局大战中，高阶1A温哥华加拿大人队于周五击败尤金翡翠队，完成三场横扫，夺得2026年西北联盟冠军。
就像系列赛的前两场一样，这场决定胜局的比赛也是交替领先的拉锯战。加拿大人队在早取得领先，但在中段局数落后，最终进入第八局时落后4分。来自安大略省里士满山的David Calabrese在第九局两出局时扭转了乾坤，轰出一记扳平比分的本垒打。
两队在第10局各得一分，并在第11局均未得分，似乎陷入了僵局。但第12局的第一球打破了这一局面，Ryan Sprock击出中外野安打，送回了超前分。加拿大人队守住领先优势，以9比8在PK球场取胜，这也是他们连续三场以1分险胜对手。
获取您附近的场次小联盟比赛门票 »
这是温哥华自2023年以来首个联盟冠军。这也是自2022年以来首次有球队在联盟冠军赛中通过横扫夺冠——当年双方的角色正好相反，尤金击败了温哥华。
加拿大人队堪称西北联盟季后赛的常客，在过去六个赛季中四次打入季后赛。今年开局步履维艰，输掉了前五场比赛，但新老面孔的结合扭转了局势，而一些赛季中期的引援则在整个季后赛冲刺和冠军赛中保持了势头。
JoJo Parker，游击手
作为蓝鸟队在2025年选秀大会的首轮新秀，Parker今年迎来了他的职业棒球初体验。目前他是球队的头号潜力新秀，他毫不浪费时间地展现了自己的天赋。他在单A达尼丁队出战87场表现出色，并于8月10日升上温哥华。这位20岁的球员状态火热，开启高阶1A生涯时打出了七场安打秀。他在加拿大人队的21场常规赛中以.316的打击率收官。
作为开路先锋，Parker在季后赛系列赛的关键时刻多次走上打击区。在第一场比赛中，他在第六局击出一支带打点的二垒安打，送回了扳平分。在第二场比赛的第八局下半，他收获了一支安打和一次保送。尽管他在第三场比赛中没有安打，但他得到了制胜分，结束了12局的僵局。总而言之，他在第一个职业赛季以几次高质量的打击和一个冠军头衔画上了句号。
Dasan Hill，左投……以及Nolan Perry，右投，和Johnny King，左投
在今年早些时候，加拿大人队的打线得到了Perry和King的投球支援，他们分别位列蓝鸟队第2和第3号潜力新秀。Perry于6月升上2A，而King则在高阶1A效力至8月，斩获全队最高的112次三振。但当两人都前往新罕布什尔后，就到了传递火炬的时候了。球队第8号潜力新秀Hill登场了。
Hill在Jeff Hoffman的交易截止日交易中加入球队，并在温哥华的冲刺阶段完成了五次关键先发，其中包括9月2.日锁定季后赛席位的比赛。他在三局投球中失1分，并三振了4名打者。这位身高6英尺5英寸的左投在第一场比赛中重返投手丘，在两局投球中失1分自责分。
David Calabrese，外野手

作为安大略省托恩希尔圣伊丽莎白天主教高中的毕业生，Calabrese于8月12日与蓝鸟队签下一份小联盟合同后重返加拿大。作为天使队在2020年选秀大会的三轮秀，他在2A火箭城开始本赛季，随后被释放。他迅速对温哥华的打线产生影响，并在常规赛的最后一周状态火热，在28打数14安打、攻击指数1.321并有5次盗垒后，荣获西北联盟周最佳球员。在季后赛开始前，他在加拿大人队的16场比赛中交出了.348的打击率、3支本垒打和10个打点。
这位23岁的球员在第一场比赛中从替补席开始，随后在第六局作为防守替补登场。他在该局下半作为首位打者击出一支三垒安打，掀起了一波反攻。在第二场比赛中，他贡献了三支安打。这些表现与他在第三场比赛第九局上半轰出的、完成4分大逆转的扳平本垒打相比都黯然失色。总的来说，他在这个系列赛中12打数6安打，包含3支长打和1次盗垒。

items.titleEn: Vlad's baserunning slipup, Scherzer's 6-run start shape series-opening loss vs. O's
bodyEn: TORONTO -- All of the Blue Jays’ momentum coming into this homestand came crashing down in a few early, ugly minutes on Friday night.

The 7-4 loss to the Orioles leaves the Blue Jays two games behind the Guardians for the final AL Wild Card spot, but at this point, they’ve got more than just the Guardians to worry about with 14 games remaining in their season.
This is what mattered most:
1. The AL Wild Card is getting messy … again

The past 10 days allowed us to focus on the Blue Jays and Guardians as they grew closer atop this race, but those days are over. Not only are the Rangers right in the mix, but the Orioles are hanging on.
This time? Objects in the mirror are closer than they appear.

The Blue Jays and Orioles have five games remaining between one another, over a third of Toronto’s remaining games. After this weekend, the Blue Jays travel to Baltimore from Sept. 21-23, their second-to-last series of the season. The Orioles haven’t been a powerhouse by any means, but which teams in this race have? The Blue Jays are currently tied 4-4 in this season's series, too, so they could end up on the wrong end of a tiebreaker.

One other factor to keep in mind: The Guardians were just 1 1/2 games back of the White Sox in the AL Central going into play on Friday night. The Blue Jays have the tiebreaker advantage over the Guardians, but not over the White Sox, so if that division lead flips down the stretch, it’s not necessarily good news for Toronto.

“Everything is a challenge right now, everything is high stakes and it’s not going to be easy,” manager John Schneider said. “But it’s about how you handle it, how you put your best foot forward and put guys in position to succeed. Everyone knows what’s ahead of us.”
2. The little things: Guerrero thrown out
September and October teach us each year that there’s no such thing as the little things. … They're all big.

In the first inning, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was thrown out on a back-pick play by Orioles catcher Samuel Basallo. Guerrero bounced just too far off the bag on the high-and-inside ball to Alejandro Kirk, but there was no need for it. With George Springer on second base in front of him, playing at something less than 100%, they weren’t about to double steal or force the issue. It was, very simply, an out the Blue Jays can’t be giving away.

“[First-base coach] Mark Budzinski was on it, kind of yelling. He didn’t hear him,” Schneider said. “He just got out too far. Baserunning plays like that can shift momentum a little bit. It could have been a little bit different after Kirk walks. He got out too far and they made a play.”

Later that inning, the Blue Jays had two men on but got only one crack at it when Nathan Lukes struck out. If Guerrero hadn’t been thrown out, perhaps another opportunity could have changed the direction of this game early on.
3. The O’s stacked it up on Mad Max

Immediately after Guerrero’s blunder and the Blue Jays stranding two runners, the Orioles piled it on. You could feel the swing of momentum in the building so clearly as Baltimore strung together six consecutive hits to open the second inning, eventually scoring five in the frame.

After surrendering a leadoff homer to Dylan Beavers to open the game in the first, this was Max Scherzer being hit by a barrage of jabs. Scherzer soon buckled down and gave the Blue Jays five innings to save the bullpen, but there are no silver linings in postseason races.

“I’m accountable for my mistakes,” Scherzer said. “In that situation, the two-strike pitch to Gunnar [Henderson], I felt I could have made a better pitch. I got hit on that, but from then on, I felt like I executed. I wasn’t leaving pitches in the heart of the plate. That’s where I have to tip my cap to them. They got base hits on pitches I put in locations I’m comfortable with. It’s frustrating. That’s baseball, I’m not going to cry about it.”

Scherzer will make at least two more starts this regular season, potentially three. He’s essentially operating as the No. 3 starter behind Dylan Cease and José Soriano with all of these injuries piled up, so there’s no way around this. The Blue Jays need Scherzer, but on Friday night, the O’s were all over him.
items.titleZh: 弗拉基米尔跑垒失误与Max Scherzer丢6分，多伦多蓝鸟主场不敌巴尔的摩金莺
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在主场以4比7不敌巴尔的摩金莺，美联外卡竞争陷入白热化。
bodyZh: 多伦多——周五晚上，蓝鸟队带着大好气势迎来本场主场系列赛，但在比赛初期的短短几分钟内，一切便急转直下。
这场4比7输给巴尔的摩金莺的比赛过后，蓝鸟队在美联外卡争夺战的末席上落后克利夫兰守护者两场胜差，但在常规赛还剩14场的情况下，他们要担心的对手已经不只是守护者队了。
以下是几个最重要的看点：
1. 美联外卡争夺战再次变得混乱……
过去10天让我们得以聚焦于蓝鸟队和守护者队，因为他们在榜首的竞争中越发接近，但那些日子已经结束了。不仅得克萨斯游骑兵紧追不舍，巴尔的摩金莺也依然留在竞争行列中。
这一次？后视镜中的物体比你想象的更近。
蓝鸟队与巴尔的摩金莺还剩五场直接对话，占了多伦多剩余比赛的三分之一以上。本周末过后，蓝鸟队将于9月21日至23日前往巴尔的摩，进行他们本赛季倒数第二场系列赛。金莺队绝算不上什么超级强队，但在这个争夺战里哪支球队又是呢？蓝鸟队本赛季的交手记录目前也以4比4平手，因此他们最终可能会在胜负平决胜机制中吃亏。
另一个需要记住的因素是：截至周五晚上的比赛开始前，守护者队在美联中区落后芝加哥白袜仅1场半胜差。蓝鸟队在对阵守护者队时拥有胜负平决胜优势，但对阵白袜队则没有，因此如果分区头名在冲刺阶段发生翻转，对多伦多来说未必是好消息。
“现在每件事都是挑战，每件事都关乎重大且绝非易事，”主教练John Schneider说。“但关键在于你如何应对，如何全力以赴并让球员处于能够成功的位置。每个人都知道我们面前有什么。”
2. 细节决定成败：Guerrero遭到触杀
九月和十月每年都在告诉我们，没有所谓的微不足道的小事……它们全都是大事。
在第一局中，Vladimir Guerrero Jr.被巴尔的摩金莺捕手Samuel Basallo通过牵制传球触杀出局。面对投向Alejandro Kirk的高位内角球，Guerrero离垒稍稍过远，但根本没必要这么做。当时George Springer正占据二垒，且身体状况未达百分之百，他们不可能发动双盗垒或强行冒险。很简单，这是蓝鸟队送不起的出局数。
“[一垒教练] Mark Budzinski当时注意到了，一直在大喊提醒。但他没听见，”Schneider说。“他离垒太远了。诸如此类的跑垒表现可能会稍微改变比赛气势。在Kirk选到四坏球保送后，情况可能会有些不同。他离垒太远了，而对方完成了守备。”
在那局稍后，蓝鸟队曾有两名跑者在垒，但随着Nathan Lukes三振出局，他们只得到了这一次进攻机会。如果Guerrero没有被触杀，或许另一个机会本可以改变这场比赛早期的走势。
3. 金莺队在Max Scherzer身上大举得分
就在Guerrero失误和蓝鸟队留下两名残垒之后，金莺队展开了猛烈进攻。随着巴尔的摩在第二局一开始就连敲六支安打，最终在该局攻下5分，球场内的气势逆转感清晰可感。
在第一局一开始就被Dylan Beavers轰出首局首打席本垒打后，这可以说是Max Scherzer遭到了对手的一轮组合拳痛击。Scherzer随后稳住阵脚，为蓝鸟队投满五局以节省牛棚，但在季后赛争夺战中是没有安慰奖的。
“我对自己的失误负有责任，”Scherzer说。“在那种情况下，投给Gunnar [Henderson]的那记两好球投球，我觉得自己本可以投得更好。我那球挨了安打，但从那以后，我觉得自己执行得很好。我没有把球投到好球带的正中心。这就是我必须向他们脱帽致敬的地方。他们在那些我感觉舒服的位置上的投球敲出了安打。这很沮丧。这就是棒球，我不会为此哭泣。”
Scherzer在这个常规赛至少还会有两次先发，潜在可能是三次。由于伤兵满营，他基本上是作为排在Dylan Cease和José Soriano之后的3号先发在登板，所以这也是无可奈何的事。蓝鸟队需要Scherzer，但在周五晚上，金莺队完全打爆了他。

items.titleEn: Could Yesavage return to aid Blue Jays' playoff push?
items.summaryEn: Santander, Bieber also progressing toward potential '26 returns
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Racing against the clock to return in time to help the Blue Jays’ postseason run, Trey Yesavage officially has a shot.

Yesavage threw 30 pitches Thursday at the club’s complex in Dunedin, Fla., simulating two innings against hitters, and came out of the session feeling fine physically. Yesavage was up to 93 mph in that session as he works his way back from surgery in early August to repair the meniscus in his left knee.
“After 30, we’ll probably want to get him to 40 or 50 pitches,” manager John Schneider said. “Then, we’ll see how that looks and how he feels. We’ll see if he needs another one or not.”
Let’s map this out, then, as a best-case scenario. Besides, the Blue Jays are due for one of those this season.

Schneider believes that Yesavage could pitch in a rehab game “later next week,” and given that the Triple-A Buffalo Bisons end their season on Sunday, Sept. 20, the clock is ticking. If Yesavage could pitch over those final few days in Triple-A while the Blue Jays are in Arlington playing the Rangers (Sept. 18-20), that would line him up to pitch again -- and on plenty of rest -- during the final series of the season against the Reds at home.

If Yesavage throws 45 pitches in this rehab game, let’s presume he could have a maximum of 60 to work with in his first game back. He’d only be able to give the Blue Jays three innings, maybe four, but his upside is worth it, especially as the Blue Jays essentially roll out two bullpen days in their rotation, one of which features the struggling Spencer Arrighetti in a bulk role.

Any injury needs to be handled seriously, especially for a long-term cornerstone in the Blue Jays’ rotation, but it’s also important that we’re talking about a knee injury here, not an elbow or shoulder. If the Blue Jays’ medical team decides that Yesavage is not risking any further damage to his meniscus, then the 23-year-old can take a real run at this. Given Yesavage’s toughness, stubbornness and early track record of rising to the moment, this has a comeback story written all over it.
The latest on: Anthony Santander
Santander (torn labrum) plays the outfield for Triple-A Buffalo again Friday night, then he’ll play through “at least the middle of next week there,” according to Schneider.

Last year, when Santander ramped up from a shoulder issue, he also ran into some back troubles along the way. Keep in mind, too, that Santander hasn’t played much these past two seasons, and for someone with a reputation of being a slow starter, it feels like he’s coming off a terribly long offseason here. Santander’s role would be uncertain, too, but for now, the Blue Jays just want him to give this a shot.
“We’ll get him playing as much as we can and see how he responds physically, and what the at-bats look like,” Schneider said. “We’re trying to cram a lot into a week here.”
The latest on: Shane Bieber
Consider Bieber to be a couple of steps behind Yesavage in his rehab from right teres major inflammation.
“The goal is throwing off the mound some time during this homestand,” Schneider said.

If that’s the case, Bieber may need another bullpen session or two before facing live hitters, and at that point of the season, Triple-A play will be wrapped. Any Bieber return likely requires the Blue Jays to make the postseason, and potentially even advance a round, but he’s still going to build up and take a run at this.

If Bieber reaches the point where he’s ready to make a “rehab start” later in September, he could pitch against his own Blue Jays teammates or even Minor League players who are brought to Toronto by the club.
items.titleZh: Yesavage能否回归助力多伦多蓝鸟冲击季后赛？
items.summaryZh: Yesavage、Anthony Santander与Shane Bieber正朝着复出稳步推进。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——为了赶在多伦多蓝鸟的季后赛征程中复出而争分夺秒，Trey Yesavage官方来看确实还有机会。
Yesavage周四在球队位于佛罗里达州达尼din的训练基地投了30球，进行了对阵打者的两局实战模拟投球，他在训练结束后身体感觉良好。在努力从8月初修复左膝半月板的手术中恢复时，Yesavage的球速达到了93英里/小时。
“在投了30球之后，我们可能会想让他把投球数提升到40或50球，”总教练John Schneider说，“然后，我们会看看情况如何以及他感觉怎样。我们再决定他是否还需要进行另一场模拟赛。”
那么，让我们以最佳情况来规划一下。此外，多伦多蓝鸟本赛季也确实需要一点好运。
Schneider认为，Yesavage可能会在“下周晚些时候”的一场复健赛中登板，鉴于三A水牛城野牛队的赛季将于9月20日星期日结束，时间已经不多了。如果Yesavage能在三A赛季的最后几天登板，而当时多伦多蓝鸟正前往阿灵顿对阵得克萨斯游骑兵（9月18日至20日），这将使他能够获得充足的休息，并在主场对阵辛辛那提红人的赛季最后系列赛中再次登板投球。
如果Yesavage在这场复健赛中投了45球，我们可以推测他在回归后的第一场比赛中最多可以投60球。他可能只能为多伦多蓝鸟投3局，也许4局，但他的上限绝对值得冒险，特别是多伦多蓝鸟的先发轮值中实际上有两场牛棚日，其中一场由表现挣扎的Spencer Arrighetti承担长中继角色。
任何伤病都需要认真处理，尤其是对于多伦多蓝鸟轮值中的长期建队基石而言，但同样重要的是，我们讨论的是膝盖受伤，而不是手肘或肩膀。如果多伦多蓝鸟的医疗团队认为Yesavage的半月板不会冒进一步受损的风险，那么这位23岁的球员就可以真正为此放手一搏。鉴于Yesavage的坚韧、顽强以及在关键时刻挺身而出的早期记录，这完全是一个充满传奇色彩的复出故事。
关于Anthony Santander的最新消息：
据Schneider透露，肩唇撕裂的Santander周五晚将再次代表三A水牛城野牛队守外野，然后他将在那里打球“至少到下周中期”。
去年，当Santander从肩部问题中恢复时，他在过程中也遇到了一些背部麻烦。另外请记住，Santander在过去两个赛季并没有打太多比赛，对于一个以慢热著称的球员来说，感觉他仿佛经历了一个漫长得可怕的休赛期。Santander的角色也将充满不确定性，但目前，多伦多蓝鸟只是希望他能尝试一下。
“我们会让他尽可能多地出场比赛，看看他的身体反应如何，以及打击表现怎样，”Schneider说，“我们正试图在这一周内塞进大量的内容。”
关于Shane Bieber的最新消息：
在从右大圆肌炎症中恢复的过程中，Biever的进度可以说是比Yesavage落后了几步。
“目标是在这次主场赛程期间的某个时候进行牛棚练投，”Schneider说。
如果是这样的话，Biever在面对实战打者之前可能还需要进行一两次牛棚练投，而到了那个赛季阶段，三A的比赛已经结束了。Biever的任何复出都可能需要多伦多蓝鸟闯入季后赛，甚至可能需要晋级一轮，但他仍将继续建立体能并为之努力。
如果Biever恢复到准备在9月晚些时候进行“复健先发”的阶段，他可以对阵多伦多蓝鸟的队友，甚至是俱乐部带到多伦多的其他小联盟球员。

items.titleEn: After 12-year journey, OF Martin called up as Blue Jays designate Sánchez
bodyEn: More than a decade in the making, Rudy Martin Jr. is reportedly heading to the big leagues.

The 30-year-old Blue Jays farmhand will be called up on Friday as Toronto opens a pivotal series at home against the Orioles, according to ESPN’s Jeff Passan. The club has not yet confirmed the move. The Blue Jays enter Friday one game behind the Guardians for the third American League Wild Card.

Martin, an outfielder, was drafted out of high school by the Royals in 2014 in the 25th round, which no longer exists in today’s 20-round Draft. He served in Kansas City’s system until 2021, when he elected free agency.

Martin has taken a winding journey to reach his Major League debut since then. He signed with the Nationals in January 2022 but was released that August. After two seasons out of affiliated baseball, which featured time in MLB Partner Leagues with the Milwaukee Milkmen of the American Association and the York Revolution of the Atlantic League, as well as with the Toros de Tijuana of the Mexican League, he re-signed with the Royals on a Minor League deal in May 2025 and stayed with the club through this year.

Martin was then traded from the Royals to the Orioles on July 18 for cash, designated for assignment two days later and claimed by the Blue Jays on July 23. Since joining Triple-A Buffalo on July 25, Martin has posted a .730 OPS with three home runs and 12 stolen bases.

A career .252 hitter in the Minors with only 50 home runs, Martin is a threat on the bases, even at 30. He has 45 steals in 91 games this season and has swiped at least 20 bags in all but two of his Minor League seasons. Tying a career high with 11 homers this year, Martin has also played his most games since 2019, crossing the 90-game mark for only the second time.

While it’s unclear exactly what role Martin will play when he joins the Blue Jays, one thing is certain: A 12-year journey to the Major Leagues will be worth celebrating when he eventually takes the field.
items.titleZh: 经历12年等待，外野手Rudy Martin升上大联盟，蓝鸟DFA了Sánchez
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟外野手Rudy Martin在经历12年的小联盟生涯后即将迎来大联盟首秀。
bodyZh: 据ESPN记者Jeff Passan报道，经过十多年的努力，Rudy Martin Jr.据报道即将登上大联盟。
这位30岁的多伦多蓝鸟小联盟球员将在周五被升上大联盟，当时多伦多正在主场展开对阵巴尔的摩金莺的关键系列赛。俱乐部尚未正式确认这一人员调整。进入周五时，蓝鸟在争夺美联第三张外卡席位上落后克利夫兰守护者一场胜差。
外野手Martin是在2014年第25轮高中选秀中被堪萨斯城皇家选中，如今20轮制的选秀中已无此轮次。他在皇家的体系中效力至2021年，随后选择成为自由球员。
自那以后，Martin开启了曲折的大联盟首秀之旅。他在2022年1月与华盛顿国民签约，但在当年8月被释出。在离开职业棒球体系两年的时间里，他曾效力于独立联盟的美国协会密尔沃基牛奶人、大西洋联盟的约克革命队，以及墨西哥联盟的蒂华纳公牛队，随后他在2025年5月与堪萨斯城皇家签下一份小联盟合同，并在今年一直留在该俱乐部。
随后，Martin于7月18日被皇家通过现金交易送到巴尔的摩金莺，两天后被指定为让渡球员，并于7月23日被多伦多蓝鸟认领。自7月25日加入3A水牛城以来，Martin交出了.730的攻击指数（OPS），并有3支本垒打和12次盗垒。
作为一名在小联盟生涯打击率为.252且只有50支本垒打的球员，现年30岁的Martin在垒间依然极具威胁。他在本赛季91场比赛中完成了45次盗垒，并且在他几乎所有的小联盟赛季中，单季盗垒数都至少达到20次。本赛季Martin追平了11支本垒打的生涯单季纪录，并且这也是他自2019年以来出场最多的一年，职业生涯中第二次出场数突破90场大关。
尽管目前尚不清楚Martin加入蓝鸟后将扮演什么角色，但有一点是肯定的：当他最终踏上球场时，这段历时12年的大联盟圆梦之旅绝对值得庆祝。

items.titleEn: Where does Cease stand in latest Pitcher Power Rankings?
bodyEn: Last Wednesday at Wrigley Field, the Cubs dinged Jacob Misiorowski for five hits, four walks and five earned runs over four innings. It was tied for his shortest outing of the year and was his first time allowing more than three earned runs.

It was a rare dent in the Miz’s armor. Was it a window opening for his talented competitors in the Starting Pitcher Power Rankings? If so, Miz quickly slammed it shut. Tuesday night brought a rematch against the rival Cubs, this time in friendlier conditions at American Family Field, and Miz looked much more like the utterly dominant pitcher who has left us in awe all season long.

So, here he is again at the top of our poll, for the seventh time in a row. But how do those challengers stack up behind him? Below you'll find the latest Starting Pitcher Power Rankings, as voted on by a panel of MLB.com experts.
(All stats are through Tuesday’s games, unless otherwise noted.)

1) Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers (Last poll: 1)We could throw around incredible Miz numbers all day, but here’s one: On Tuesday night, he threw his 1,000th pitch of 100-plus mph this season, ultimately getting that total up to 1,010. The previous single-season record for the pitch-tracking era (2008-present) is far in the rearview mirror: 673 by Jordan Hicks in 2018. (The most thrown in a starting role is far below that: 337 by Hunter Greene in 2022.) In fact, no entire team has thrown even 700 triple-digit pitches in a season. Even if you look over the entirety of the pitch-tracking era (all 19 seasons), just 14 teams other than the Brewers have 1,000 pitches of 100-plus mph from all of their pitchers, combined. Miz is on a different planet.

2) Cam Schlittler, Yankees (2)Rather than fading down the stretch in his first full MLB season, Schlittler just keeps tightening his grip on the AL Cy Young Award race. Since a slight rough patch from late June to early August, he’s put together a streak of six consecutive starts with no more than one run allowed. During that stretch, Schlittler has a 1.15 ERA, struck out 49 batters in 39 innings and held opponents to a .150 batting average.

3) Chris Sale, Braves (4)Despite Misiorowski's utter dominance, Sale has been doing his best to make the NL Cy Young Award race interesting. The 37-year-old lefty is, incredibly, throwing harder than ever-- and harder than nearly any starting pitcher his age has in the pitch-tracking era. Thanks in part to that heat, he’s posted a 1.90 ERA and 1.23 FIP over a streak of eight consecutive quality starts. Since the start of August, he’s stared down a bear of a schedule -- facing the Yankees, D-backs, Brewers, Dodgers and Phillies -- and refused to blink, striking out 41 and walking just three.

4) Jesús Luzardo, Phillies (T-7)If Sale has been keeping contact with Misiorowski in that race for a while now, Luzardo is the dark horse who’s been making a late but incredibly spirited charge from the outside. His latest burst came on Monday, when Luzardo twirled only the 10th individual shutout of the 2026 season -- and did so while striking out 12 in a crucial showdown with the NL East-leading Braves. The left-hander allowed five earned runs or more in four of his first eight starts this season but since that point has a 1.93 ERA in 21 outings in which the Phillies have gone 18-3.

5) Cristopher Sánchez, Phillies (5)Sánchez has fallen off a bit after his 50 2/3-inning scoreless streak ended on June 3, but it’s nice when “fallen off” amounts to a 3.60 ERA and 3.32 FIP over 16 starts. (Subtract one anomalous disaster start on July 6 at Kansas City, when he gave up nine earned runs, and Sánchez’s ERA over that stretch would go down to 2.85. His season-long ERA would drop from 2.58 to 2.17.) It’s still been an absolutely incredible two-year run for the lefty, who has a good shot to finish top-two in the Majors in both major forms of WAR for the second season in a row.

6) Dylan Cease, Blue Jays (3)With Schlittler on a roll, Cease might not have been able to afford the rare hiccup he had on Monday in West Sacramento, allowing five runs (four earned) over five innings against the Athletics. That interrupted a stretch of 11 starts in which Cease posted a 1.36 ERA. If Cease ultimately finishes second in a Cy race for the second time in his career -- he also was runner-up to Justin Verlander in 2022 -- a short stint on the injured list in late May and early June for a left hamstring strain might prove to be costly.

7) Parker Messick, Guardians (10)Since Messick made his Major League debut last Aug. 20, here are the only pitchers with a lower ERA than his 2.57 in at least 200 innings: Schlittler, Sale, Skubal and Sánchez. Cleveland’s second-round pick in the 2022 Draft has been instrumental to keeping his team in the playoff chase, and he’s been dialing up the strikeouts of late, notching each of the first three double-digit K performances of his career since mid-June. That includes a career-high 12 in his last start, on Saturday against the Tigers.

8) Yoshinobu Yamamoto, Dodgers (6)The Dodgers’ rotation is talented but chaotic. Shohei Ohtani, Blake Snell, Tyler Glasnow, Roki Sasaki and Justin Wrobleski have all missed time due to injuries. Emmet Sheehan was demoted to Triple-A and is now back. Tarik Skubal was acquired at the Trade Deadline. But there’s no chaos with Yamamoto -- just talent and consistency. He’s made every start and completed at least six innings 22 of 25 times, with the Dodgers going 16-9. Since June, Yamamoto’s ERA has hovered between 2.49 and 2.86 after each outing.

9) Drew Rasmussen, Rays (9)In May 2021, the Brewers traded Rasmussen to the Rays in a deal that sent Willy Adames back to Milwaukee. Since then, Rasmussen has pitched 581 2/3 innings for Tampa Bay and posted a 2.77 ERA, with his current 2.88 mark the highest in any season. Of the 98 pitchers to clear the 500-inning threshold since Rasmussen’s Rays debut, only Ohtani, Snell, Sale and Max Fried can beat his ERA. The righty has been locked in lately, too. The Rays have won each of his past nine starts, and he has a 2.17 ERA over that span.

10) Tarik Skubal, Dodgers (not ranked)It doesn’t feel as though Skubal has completely hit his stride yet as a Dodger. In seven starts since arriving from Detroit, he’s only struck out more than seven batters once. On Sept. 3, he gave up 10 hits against the Cardinals. And yet … Skubal owns a 2.93 ERA and 2.53 FIP in Dodger Blue, with a 48-to-10 K-to-BB ratio and only three homers allowed. Just about any pitcher in baseball would kill for those numbers.

Others receiving votes: Reid Detmers (Angels), Payton Tolle (Red Sox), Nolan McLean (Mets), Sonny Gray (Red Sox), Logan Henderson (Brewers), Blake Snell (Dodgers), Gavin Williams (Guardians), Chase Burns (Reds), Cade Cavalli (Nationals), Tyler Mahle (Braves)
Voters: David Adler, Jason Foster, Jared Greenspan, Brian Murphy, Max Ralph, Shanthi Sepe-Chepuru, Andrew Simon
items.titleZh: Dylan Cease在最新先发投手实力榜排名如何？
items.summaryZh: 最新MLB先发投手实力榜出炉，Jacob Misiorowski继续领跑，Dylan Cease位列第六。
bodyZh: 上周三在瑞格利球场，芝加哥小熊在四局内对Jacob Misiorowski敲出5支安打、选到4次保送并攻下5分自责分。这追平了他本季最短的单场投球局数，也是他首次单场失掉超过3分自责分。
这是这位“Miz”盔甲上罕见的裂痕。这会为他在先发投手实力榜上的强劲竞争对手们打开一扇窗吗？如果是的话，Miz很快就将其关上了。周二晚上，双方在美国家庭球场迎来了对阵芝加哥小熊的宿敌重赛，这次在更熟悉的球场环境下，Miz看起来更像是那个整个赛季都让我们叹为观止、极具统治力的投手。
因此，他再次回到了我们民调的榜首，连续第七次登顶。但身后的那些挑战者们表现如何呢？在下方，您可以看到由MLB.com专家小组投票选出的最新先发投手实力榜。
（除非另有说明，所有统计数据均截至周二的比赛。）

1) Jacob Misiorowski，密尔沃基酿酒人（上期排名：1）我们可以整天讨论Miz那些不可思议的数据，但这里有一个：周二晚上，他投出了本季第1,000球球速超过100英里的投球，最终将这一数字提升至1,010球。球速追踪时代（2008年至今）此前的单赛季纪录早已被远远甩在身后：那是Jordan Hicks在2018年创下的673球。（而在先发角色中投出的最高纪录则要低得多：Hunter Greene在2022年创下的337球。）事实上，没有任何一支球队能在单个赛季中投出过700球的三位数球速。即使你回顾整个球速追踪时代（全部19个赛季），除了酿酒人之外，也只有14支球队的所有投手加起来能投出1,000球的100英里以上速球。Miz身处另一个星球。
2) Cam Schlittler，纽约洋基（2）在自己的首个完整大联盟赛季末段，Schlittler非但没有体能下滑，反而进一步巩固了自己对美联赛扬奖争夺战的掌控。自6月下旬到8月初的一小段低谷期以来，他交出了一连串连续6场先发失分不超过1分的表现。在此期间，Schlittler的自责分率为1.15，在39局中三振了49名打者，并将对手的打击率压制在.150。

3) Chris Sale，亚特兰大勇士（4）尽管Misiorowski展现出绝对的统治力，但Sale一直在尽最大努力让国联赛扬奖的争夺变得悬念迭起。这位37岁的左投不可思议地投出了比以往更快的球速——也比球速追踪时代中几乎任何同龄先发投手都要快。部分得益于这股火热状态，他在连续8场优质先发的过程中交出了1.90的自责分率和1.23的独立自责分率（FIP）。自8月初以来，他迎难而上地面对了一赛程极具挑战性的魔鬼赛程——先后对阵纽约洋基、亚利桑那响尾蛇、密尔沃基酿酒人、洛杉矶道奇以及费城费城人——却始终面不改色，送出41次三振仅有3次保送。

4) Jesús Luzardo，费城费城人（T-7）如果说Sale此前一直在赛扬奖争夺战中紧咬Misiorowski，那么Luzardo就是那匹从外部发起迟来但极其迅猛冲击的黑马。他的最新高光时刻出现在周一，Luzardo投出了2026赛季的第10场完封胜——并且是在与领头羊亚特兰大勇士的的关键对决中送出12次三振完成的。这位左投在本赛季前8场先发中有4场丢掉5分或以上自责分，但自那以后他在21场出赛中交出了1.93的自责分率，而费城费城人在这些比赛中取得了18胜3负的战绩。

5) Cristopher Sánchez，费城费城人（5）在6月3日连续50又3/3局无失分的纪录终结后，Sánchez的状态略有回落，但当所谓的“回落”意味着在16场先发中交出3.60的自责分率和3.32的独立自责分率（FIP）时，这已经相当不错了。（如果扣除7月6日在堪萨斯城那场丢掉9分自责分的异常灾难战，Sánchez在此期间的自责分率将降至2.85。他全季的自责分率也将从2.58降至2.17。）对于这位左投来说，这依然是绝对不可思议的两年，他很有希望连续第二年在两项主要胜利贡献值（WAR）统计中杀入大联盟前二。

6) Dylan Cease，多伦多蓝鸟（3）随着Schlittler状态正佳，Cease可能无法承受他在周一于西萨克拉门托遭遇的罕见低谷，当时他在面对运动家时投了5局丢掉5分（4分自责分）。这打断了Cease连续11场先发自责分率保持在1.36的强劲势头。如果Cease最终在赛扬奖评选中职业生涯第二次获得第二名——他在2022年也曾不敌Justin Verlander屈居亚军——那么他在5月下旬因左大腿拉伤而短暂进入伤病名单，可能将证明代价高昂。

7) Parker Messick，克利夫兰守护者（10）自从Messick在去年8月20日完成大联盟首秀以来，在至少投满200局的投手中，自责分率低于他2.57的仅有：Schlittler、Sale、Skubal和Sánchez。这位克利夫兰在2022年选秀大会第二轮选中的球员，对于球队保留季后赛希望起到了关键作用，他最近还提升了三振率，自6月中旬以来连续三场比赛完成了职业生涯首次单场双位数三振。这包括他在周六对阵底特律老虎的比赛中创下职业生涯新高的12次三振。

8) Yoshinobu Yamamoto，洛杉矶道奇（6）道奇的轮值才华横溢却又充满动荡。大谷翔平、Blake Snell、Tyler Glasnow、Roki Sasaki和Justin Wrobleski都曾因伤缺阵。Emmet Sheehan被下放小联盟后如今又回归了。Tarik Skubal是在交易截止日通过交易得到的。但Yamamoto这里没有任何动荡——只有天赋和稳定性。他完成了每一次先发，并且在25次登场中有22次至少投满6局，道奇在这些比赛中取得了16胜9负的战绩。自6月以来，Yamamoto每次登场后的自责分率一直徘徊在2.49到2.86之间。

9) Drew Rasmussen，坦帕湾光芒（9）在2021年5月，酿酒人将Rasmussen交易至光芒，将Willy Adames送回密尔沃基。自那以后，Rasmussen为坦帕湾投了581又2/3局，自责分率达到2.77，而他目前的2.88则是各赛季中最高的。在自Rasmussen代表光芒首秀以来投满500局局数门槛的98名投手中，只有大谷翔平、Blake Snell、Sale和Max Fried的自责分率能胜过他。这位右投最近也进入了绝佳状态。光芒赢下了他过去的每一场先发，在此期间他的自责分率为2.17。

10) Tarik Skubal，洛杉矶道奇（未入榜）人们并不觉得Skubal作为一名道奇球员已经完全找回了最佳状态。自底特律加盟以来的7场先发中，他只有一次单场送出超过7次三振。9月3日，他在对阵圣路易斯红雀时被敲出10支安打。然而……Skubal身披道奇球衣交出了2.93的自责分率和2.53的独立自责分率（FIP），三振保送比为48比10，且仅被敲出3支本垒打。棒球场上的几乎任何投手都会为这些数据垂涎三尺。

其他获得选票的球员：Reid Detmers（洛杉矶天使）、Payton Tolle（波士顿红袜）、Nolan McLean（纽约大都会）、Sonny Gray（波士顿红袜）、Logan Henderson（密尔沃基酿酒人）、Blake Snell（洛杉矶道奇）、Gavin Williams（克利夫兰守护者）、Chase Burns（辛辛那提红人）、Cade Cavalli（华盛顿国民）、Tyler Mahle（亚特兰大勇士）

items.titleEn: Miles was a Rule 5 long shot. Now, he's an indispensable Blue Jays arm
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from the Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
After a 2025 Arizona Fall League season that put him back on the baseball radar, the goal was simple for Spencer Miles: Make it to The Show.
“If I make the big leagues next year,” Miles told MLB.com’s Maria Guardado last October, “that’d be nice.”

During an outstanding rookie season for the Blue Jays, Miles has done a lot more than simply make his MLB debut. The Rule 5 Draft pick has filled practically every role on Toronto’s pitching staff and has done so admirably, lowering his ERA to 2.77 and picking up his second career save with a perfect two-inning outing on Tuesday against the Athletics.

“I’m kind of running out of words for Spence,” manager John Schneider said. “He’s been unbelievably important to us: starter, opener, reliever, low leverage, high leverage. It’s been 80-some-odd innings of really quality work.”

Miles is crucial to a Blue Jays club fighting for an American League Wild Card spot in the season’s final month. After a second-half surge, Toronto enters Wednesday at 73-73, just one game behind Cleveland for the third and final AL Wild Card berth.
“It’s kind of crazy, especially your first year, you know?” Miles told MLB.com. “We’re clawing back and trying to get back into things. It’s been a wild ride.”

Just how wild? Think of it this way: Twelve months ago, Miles was still recovering from Tommy John surgery. He hadn’t thrown a competitive pitch since June 2024, and he had never pitched above the Single-A level.

But the AFL changed everything. Then in the Giants organization, Miles tossed 8 2/3 innings for the Scottsdale Scorpions, striking out 12. He allowed four earned runs for a 4.15 ERA, but it was a successful showcase: Miles had put himself on team radars.
“Before the Fall League, no chance, because you have no sample size,” Miles said. “That would have been a freaking dark horse, long shot, but here we are.”

On Dec. 10, the Blue Jays took Miles with the 10th pick in the Rule 5 Draft. Needing to make the big league club or be offered back to San Francisco, Miles posted a 3.72 ERA in seven Grapefruit League games, striking out 11 in 9 2/3 innings, and made Toronto’s Opening Day roster.
“It was huge. It showed that they trusted me,” he said. “I don’t think I had a great Spring Training, but I showcased enough for them to trust me and give me a chance.”

Miles has run with that chance. Since earning the win in his Major League debut against the A’s at Rogers Centre, he’s been a reliable option either as a starter or out of the bullpen. His workload is building up late in the season, which could be a concern for a pitcher coming off a lost year due to injury, but Miles feels good, and the Blue Jays trust him.

“We’re trying to find the best way to utilize him down the stretch with some vacancies in the rotation and trying to get the most meaningful innings out of him in whatever role that may be,” Schneider said.

Miles’ sinker -- the most-used offering in his five-pitch repertoire -- has been one of the most effective pitches in the Majors, ranking seventh in MLB and second among sinkers with a +19 pitching run value.

The right-hander doesn’t get many swings and misses, but he’s adept at limiting hard contact: Miles’ 3.6% barrel rate ranks in the 95th percentile in the Majors. After all, it’s hard to barrel up a pitcher who keeps the ball on the ground: Miles has a 51.8% ground-ball rate in 2026 (89th percentile).

It’s been a rather seamless adjustment to the big leagues for a pitcher who not too long ago was a 140-pound “late bloomer” in high school. But Miles earned a walk-on roster spot at Missouri and pitched his way to a fourth-round selection by the Giants in the 2022 Draft. A back injury late that season cost him all of '23 before Tommy John surgery wiped out half of the following season and the entirety of ’25, but Miles is on the sunny side of what he acknowledged has been “a long journey.”

“It’s been amazing,” he said. “It’s been a great clubhouse, a great group of guys, great coaching staff. Instilled a lot of confidence in me and allowed me to trust my stuff and go out there and be myself.”
items.titleZh: Miles曾是规则五选秀的不确定因素，如今他已成为多伦多蓝鸟不可或缺的投手
items.summaryZh: Spencer Miles从规则五选秀的未知数成长为多伦多蓝鸟牛棚与先发的重要战力，在球队冲击季后赛的关键阶段表现亮眼。
bodyZh: 本文摘选自蓝鸟动态通讯。若要阅读完整通讯，请点击此处，并订阅以将内容定期发送至您的收件箱。
在经历了2025年亚利桑那秋季联盟的历练并重新回到棒球视野后，Spencer Miles的目标很简单：登上大联盟。
“如果我明年能打上大联盟，”Spencer Miles去年10月告诉MLB.com的Maria Guardado，“那就太好了。”
在为蓝鸟效力的出色新秀赛季中，Spencer Miles做到了不仅仅是完成大联盟首秀。这位规则五选秀新秀几乎填补了多伦多投手阵容中的每一个角色，并且表现出色，他在周二对阵运动家的比赛中投出完美的两局，将自责分率降至2.77，并收获了职业生涯第二场救援成功。
“我对Spence已经快找不到赞美的词了，”总教练John Schneider说，“他对我们有着难以置信的重要意义：先发投手、假先发、后援投手、低压局面、高压局面。他已经完成了八十多局非常高质量的工作。”
在蓝鸟于赛季最后一个月争夺美国联盟外卡席位的过程中，Spencer Miles至关重要。经历下半季的冲刺后，多伦多在周三到来时战绩为73胜73负，距离美联第三也是最后一个外卡席位落后克利夫兰一场胜差。
“这有点疯狂，尤其是作为你的第一年，你知道的吗？”Spencer Miles告诉MLB.com，“我们正在奋起直追，试图重回正轨。这是一段疯狂的旅程。”
究竟有多疯狂？可以这样想：十二个月前，Spencer Miles还在从汤米·约翰手术中恢复。自2024年6月以来，他从未投过一场正式比赛，并且从未在单A级别以上投过球。
但秋季联盟改变了一切。当时还在旧金山巨人体系效力的Spencer Miles为斯科茨代尔蝎子队投了8又2/3局，三振12次。他失掉4分责责分率是4.15，但这是一次成功的展示：Spencer Miles把自己放到了球队的雷达上。
“在秋季联盟之前，根本没机会，因为你没有任何样本量，”Spencer Miles说，“那本来会是一个疯狂的黑马、极其渺茫的机会，但我们现在做到了。”
12月10日，蓝鸟在规则五选秀中以第10顺位选中了Spencer Miles。由于必须留在大联盟阵容中否则就要被退回给旧金山，Spencer Miles在7场葡萄柚联盟比赛中交出3.72的自责分率，在9又2/3局中三振11次，并成功入选多伦多开幕战大联盟名单。
“这意义重大。这表明他们信任我，”他说，“我不认为我的春训表现有多棒，但我展示了足够多的东西，让他们信任我并给我一个机会。”
Spencer Miles抓住了这个机会。自从在罗杰斯中心对阵运动家的大联盟首秀中赢得胜投以来，他无论作为先发投手还是从牛棚出发，都是一个可靠的选择。他的工作量在赛季后期不断增加因伤报销一年后复出的投手这可能会令人担忧，但Spencer Miles感觉很好，蓝鸟也信任他。
“我们正试图找到最佳方式在最后阶段利用他，因为轮换阵容中有些空缺，并且无论扮演什么角色，都要从他身上榨取最有价值的投球局数，”John Schneider说。
Spencer Miles的伸卡球——在他五种球路中最常使用的武器——是大联盟中最有效的球路之一，凭借+19的投球跑分价值，在MLB排名第七，在伸卡球中排名第二。
这位右投没有获得太多的挥空率，但他善于限制强劲击球：Spencer Miles的3.6%桶击率在大联盟中排在第95百分位。毕竟，很难对一个能把球压得很低的投手造成有效重击：Spencer Miles在2026年的滚地球率为51.8%（第95百分位）。
对于一位不久前在高中时还是个140磅的“大器晚成者”的投手来说，适应大联盟的过程相当无缝。但Spencer Miles在密苏里大学赢得了自荐入队的名额，并凭借出色表现入选，在2022年选秀中于第四轮被巨人选中。该赛季末的背伤让他缺席了整个2023年，随后汤米·约翰手术又剥夺了他接下来赛季的一半以及整个2025年，但Spencer Miles正处于他所承认的“漫长旅程”的光明一面。
“这太棒了，”他说，“这里有一个伟大的俱乐部会所，一群很棒的队友，伟大的教练组。这给我注入了很大的信心，让我能够信任自己的球路，走上球场做自己。”

items.titleEn: Santander embarks on rehab journey, hopes to debut before end of season
bodyEn: Blue Jays outfielder Anthony Santander began a Minor League rehab assignment on Wednesday as he works his way back from surgery in February to repair a torn left shoulder labrum.
Santander played for Triple-A Buffalo against Charlotte as he seeks to make his season debut for Toronto before the regular season concludes in under three weeks.
Here’s what you need to know:
How did Santander perform?
In four trips to the plate as the Bisons’ designated hitter on Wednesday, Santander went 0-for-4 with a pair of groundouts, a pop-out to third and a strikeout.
What’s next?

Santander, who turns 32 in October, is expected to need a lengthy, Spring Training-style ramp-up before he can be activated off the injured list since he hasn’t seen game action since last year’s American League Championship Series against the Mariners.
After serving as Buffalo’s DH on Wednesday, Santander will begin getting reps in the outfield.
What are they saying?

According to Blue Jays manager John Schneider, the club wants to be sure Santander gets enough plate appearances during the rehab assignment before having him rejoin the Major League roster, particularly given how long he’s been sidelined and his history of slow starts offensively.
“It’ll be a handful of games, at least,” Schneider said. “We want to see how he’s feeling, how he’s hitting the ball. We’ll definitely be in touch with him once he gets rolling.
“ … He’s notoriously kind of a slow starter, too, so we want to make sure that he’s functioning at the normal level that he can. If he can help us, it’d be great.”
What else?

When healthy, Santander has shown he can be a difference-maker in the middle of a lineup. The switch-hitting slugger belted 44 home runs with an .814 OPS in an All-Star campaign for the Orioles in 2024.

But due to shoulder, hip and back injuries in 2025, Santander has only appeared in 54 games for the Blue Jays after joining Toronto on a five-year, $92.5 million contract prior to last season. Over those 54 games, he produced a .175/.271/.294 slash line with six home runs in 221 plate appearances.
items.titleZh: Anthony Santander开始复健赛，希望在赛季结束前迎来复出
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟外野手Anthony Santander周三开始在小联盟进行复健赛，力争在常规赛结束前复出。
bodyZh: 多伦多蓝鸟外野手Anthony Santander于周三开始了一项小联盟复健赛，他正在努力从2月份为修复左肩关节唇撕裂而接受的手术中恢复过来。
Santander代表3A级别的水牛城迎战夏洛特，他力争在不到三周后常规赛结束前，完成他在多伦多的赛季首秀。
以下是你需要了解的内容：
Santander表现如何？
周三作为Bisons队的指定打击，Santander在四次打席中4打数0安打，其中包括两次滚地出局、一次三垒方向高飞球出局以及一次三振。
接下来是什么？
由于自去年对阵西雅图水手的美国联盟冠军赛以来就没有参加过比赛，即将于10月年满32岁的Santander预计在从伤病名单中激活之前，需要经历一个类似春训的较长适应期。
在周三担任水牛城队的指定打击后，Santander将开始在外野进行守备训练。
他们是怎么说的？
据多伦多蓝鸟总教练John Schneider透露，俱乐部希望确保Santander在复健赛期间获得足够的打席数，然后再让他重返大联盟名单，特别是考虑到他缺阵的时间以及他历来开局慢热的历史。
“至少会打几场比赛，”John Schneider说道。“我们想看看他的感觉如何，击球效果怎样。一旦他进入状态，我们绝对会与他保持联系。”
“……而且他历来都是个慢热的球员，所以我们要确保他能以正常的水平发挥。如果他能帮到我们，那就太棒了。”
还有什么？
在保持健康的情况下，Santander已经证明了自己能够成为打线核心的X因素。这位左右开弓的长打者在2024年效力巴尔的摩金莺时入选全明星赛，轰出了44支本垒打，攻击指数（OPS）达到.814。
但在2025年饱受肩部、臀部和背部伤病困扰后，Santander在去年赛季前与多伦多签下五年9250万美元合同以来，仅为多伦多蓝鸟出场54场比赛。在这54场比赛中，他在221个打席中交出了.175/.271/.294的打击三围，并有6支本垒打。
